---
title: "Topic 7: Technology Adoption"
---

*Use at baseline and endline. Drawn primarily from the Firms Adoption of Technology (FAT) Survey.*

---

**7.1 Which of the following general-purpose technologies does your company currently use in its operations?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machines
- Industrial robots or automated production systems
- 3D printing / additive manufacturing
- Laser cutting or precision machining
- Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software
- Supply chain management software
- None of the above

*Source: FAT. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**7.2 How did your company acquire the technologies it currently uses?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Purchased off-the-shelf from a supplier
- Customised by a supplier to our specifications
- Developed in-house
- Acquired through a partnership or joint venture
- Licensed from another company or institution

*Source: FAT. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**7.3 In the last three years, did your company adopt any technologies that were new to your firm (even if not new to the market)?**
- Yes
- No

*Source: FAT / CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**7.4 What was the main driver of your company's most recent technology adoption?**
- To reduce production costs
- To improve product or service quality
- To enter new markets
- To comply with regulations or standards
- To respond to competitive pressure
- Following advice from a consultant or technology provider
- Access to a public support programme or grant
- Other (please specify)

*Source: FAT. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**7.5 What were the main barriers to technology adoption your company faced in the last three years?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- High upfront cost of technologies
- Lack of access to finance
- Lack of technical skills within the firm
- Lack of awareness of available technologies
- Difficulty integrating new technology with existing systems
- Uncertain return on investment
- No suitable technology available for our needs
- No barriers

*Source: FAT. Use at: Baseline.*

---

**7.6 How much did your company spend on purchasing or licensing technologies (hardware and software combined) in the last financial year?**
*(Open numeric field, in €)*

*Source: FAT / WBES. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**7.7 Did your company receive any external support (advice, training, subsidies) to help adopt new technologies in the last three years?**
- Yes — from a public programme
- Yes — from a private consultant or supplier
- Yes — from a business association or cluster
- No

*Source: FAT. Use at: Baseline.*
